brief:
Chris Hedges will conduct a speaking tour across California in November centered on his book about the Gaza conflict, The Chris Hedges Report announced. The tour, titled "Requiem for Gaza," will feature Hedges discussing the humanitarian and political dimensions of the crisis. Tickets are available for purchase.

The tour represents Hedges' efforts to bring his reporting on Gaza to wider audiences across the state during a period of sustained international attention to the conflict.
